why: Found while building, on the planted fixture, before any measured run. The check compared every section of the Go document other than functions, under loop_forms and without it, for equality. Under the opt-in the coverage section's debt lacks exactly the debt entries the frontend writes for a loop body it cannot enumerate ('another loop on a path of one iteration (nested or after the exit): no loop body'), for the bodies the opt-in now enumerates (frontend_forms (6a), (6b)): a debt entry records a loop body not emitted, so it moves with the body by construction. The check now removes from the extraction without the opt-in those OtherLoop debt entries of functions whose loop bodies all have paths under it, and compares the rest of coverage, and every other section, for equality as before. P1's claim (without loop_forms no function has loop_forms or a next path, and the opt-in changes nothing else) is unchanged; no assertion is weakened beyond the one recorded difference.
